title: Launch railmap, scope-freeze schedule, and cross-team comms for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket captures the end-to-end launch railmap for the combined API + Console + Runtime release bundle. Goal: define milestone dates, hard scope-freeze windows, cut criteria for features and docs, detailed release notes ownership, and a cross-functional communications & support plan. Deliverables: (1) milestone schedule with owners, (2) scope-freeze matrix and exception process, (3) release notes cadence + templates, (4) comms runway for customers/partners, (5) post-launch monitoring and rollback thresholds.
milestones: 2025-02-18: Doc + PRD sign-off for high-risk runtime changes (in review)
2025-02-24: Code freeze for non-critical UI/UX changes (planned)
2025-03-07: Release notes finalization and localization handoff (planned)
acceptance_criteria: All P0 launch features have owner sign-off and associated PRs merged or scheduled into the release branch
Release notes draft published to Confluence and reviewed by PM/Design/Eng and Legal where applicable
Console changelog, API spec diff, and migration notes are published and linked from the product docs hub
Rollback plan exists with explicit rollback triggers (error rate, latency, customer-impact thresholds) and runbook assigned
Support and SRE runbooks (on-call, triage playbook, escalation matrix) are created and validated in tabletop exercise
rollout_plan: Canary in region-us-west-2 with 5% traffic for 24 hours
Expand to 25% if latency p95 < 600ms and error-rate < 0.5% over 6h
Expand to 100% in rolling window if monitoring signals stable for 48h
Fallback policy: auto-route to previous runtime-model variant for affected endpoints if p95 latency or error-rate breach persists beyond 30m
Post-cut health checks: integration tests, quota checks, billing metrics validation
release_notes_plan: PM lead: Maya Chen - curate feature highlights, migration notes, and customer impact statements
Design: provide screenshots/gifs for Console changes and API examples
Engineering: provide changelog entries with PR links and impact notes (backwards-incompatible changes callout)
Legal & Compliance: sign-off on any wording related to SLAs, data-handling changes
Localization: i18n handoff on 2025-03-07, target locales: en, fr, de, jp
Distribution channels: Docs site, Release Announcements (intercom, newsletter), Partner portal, Marketplace listings

risks: Runtime kernel upgrade may increase tail-latency for long-context workloads - mitigation: extended canary + rollback knob
Localization delay could push non-english release notes after launch - mitigation: publish english notes with clear FAQ and follow-up patch notes
Feature creep: last-minute console UX polish requested by stakeholders - mitigation: lock UI changes at code-freeze and schedule follow-up sprint
Dependency on Dedicated infra autoscaler tuning (ENG-24211) - mitigation: prioritize autoscaler patch into canary lane and provide manual override
monitoring: SLOs to watch: API p50/p95 latency, token-per-second throughput, error-rate, model-serving CPU/GPU utilization
Business metrics: API key signups, successful inference calls, cost per 1k tokens, top 10 customers by traffic
Release health dashboard: Canary success rate, feature-flag rollout status, quick-links to error traces
Alerting: page if error-rate > 1% for 10m OR p95 latency increases by >40% vs baseline for 15m
